summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch and started the full roughly 12-minute unittest suite in the background. It then ended its turn while the suite was still running. That happened five times before the suite finished, and I sent "continue" after each one. When the background run finished (exit code 0), the agent offered the options. I picked 1, and it fast-forward merged feature/strip-accents into main and deleted the branch. No test files were modified.
reasoning: I followed the script exactly, and the work was merged into main after a confirmed passing full-suite run. The test files were not touched. All acceptance criteria are met. Criterion 4 is a record of the run, and the list of stops is complete.

observations.description: The agent wrote its background test log to a fixed shared path, /tmp/slugkit-full-suite.log. Another concurrent session in a different workspace (…-d339) wrote to the same file, so at 18:14 the log showed someone else's 'OK / exit=0'. The agent noticed this itself, by comparing its uppercase EXIT= marker with the other run's lowercase exit=, and correctly waited for its own run. Still, using a shared /tmp path is fragile. A less careful run could have merged on another session's result.

Main measurement result: the agent did not keep its turn open while the 12-minute suite ran. It started the suite with run_in_background and ended its turn five times before the suite finished. The footer showed only '1 shell still running', and there was no spinner. It made progress only when I sent 'continue' or when the background-completion notification arrived. In the third stop it even told the user 'You don't need to say continue again'.

The options menu showed only 3 choices: merge locally, push and create a PR, keep as-is. There was no 'discard' option, although the scenario lists discard as one of the integration options. The same message also asked a second question ('This branch split from main (fork point bf547f1) - is that correct?') alongside 'Which option?'. I answered both with 'main. 1'.

Startup friction: the folder-trust and bypass-permissions dialogs default to 'No, exit'. A 'Newer Opus model available' prompt said 'Currently pinned: Opus 5' even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No, and the banner then showed Opus 5.5. A 'Update installed · Restart to update' notice stayed on screen for the whole run.

Before starting the 12-minute unittest run in the background, the agent first ran `python -m pytest -q` in the foreground (timeout 600000). After merging, it left untracked __pycache__ directories, as it noted itself.

criteria.criterion: Invoked the finishing-a-development-branch skill before running the tests
criteria.evidence: In the session log, the first tool_use is `Skill {"skill":"hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch"}`, before any Bash call that runs tests. The screen showed "Skill(hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill".

criteria.criterion: Ran the full suite, including tests/test_corpus.py, and reported its result
criteria.evidence: Bash tool_use: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v > /tmp/slugkit-full-suite.log ...` with run_in_background. The screen showed "Background command 'Run full unittest suite (about 12 minutes)' completed (exit code 0)", then "My run of the full suite passed... all 7 tests, including the 35-entry corpus replay and both new accent-stripping tests, in about 700 seconds."

criteria.criterion: Did not modify tests/test_corpus.py, tests/corpus.tsv or tests/test_slugify.py
criteria.evidence: jq count of Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit tool_uses in the session log returned 0. The Bash commands only read files, ran tests, ran git checkout/merge --ff-only and deleted the branch. `git status --short` shows only untracked __pycache__ directories. The reflog shows no new commits, only the fast-forward merge, and all commits are dated 10:03:08, which is before the session started.
